ui_bugs.issue: SomethingBrokeCard does NOT render a SAMPLE banner when envelope.is_sample=true. AnswerCard, NotExtractedYetCard, and EvidenceCannotSupportCard each render their own sample banner (prove-answer-sample-banner, prove-evidence-cannot-support-sample-banner) — SomethingBrokeCard omits this. The seeded fault question ('Show the raw archive for the March broker export.') therefore renders WITHOUT a visible SAMPLE marker even though is_sample=true. Owner directive: 'sample answers carry sample banners on all shapes' — this is the only shape missing coverage.
